## Changelog

### Bug fixes and improvements

- EML Lib can now launch Minecraft 1.6+ Vanilla and modded on Windows 11 arm64 and macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon).
  - Minecraft 1.19+: official native support for Windows 11 arm64 and macOS arm64;
  - Minecraft 1.6-1.18: emulation for Windows 11 arm64, non-official native support for macOS arm64 (using updated/patched libraries and natives).
- Fixed a bug where Log4Shell was not being patched for non-stable versions of Minecraft.
- Fixed a bug where old Forge versions were not being correctly extracted and launched.
- Improved logging with color-coded log levels and better formatting, using official client logging configuration.
